measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmarks measure general safety categories including violence, illegal acts, sexual content, personally identifiable information, self-harm, unethical acts (including bias and discrimination, but without specific mention of religion), politically sensitive topics, copyright violation, and jailbreak attempts.
